"ジクロノス", "image": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "variantName": "月蝕亜種", "variantImage": "data:image/jpeg;base64,"}];
"use strict";

(() => {
  // 提供CSVの対象漢字が初めて登場する順。問題番号・CSV本体は変更しない。
  const kanji = Array.from("木大小一二三四五六七八九十子空先生男女手天青文字正見学校山水雨上下日火田川竹月車人気糸目玉村白土音花休虫金本森出中町入赤耳王口年立草名夕百円千犬早貝林右足石左力");
  const headers = ["番号", "対象漢字", "出題語彙", "正しい読み", "間違い①（候補）", "間違い②（候補）", "確認状況"];

  function parseCSV(text) {
    const rows = [];
    let row = [], field = "", quoted = false, closed = false;
    const source = text.replace(/^\uFEFF/, "");
    for (let index = 0; index < source.length; index += 1) {
      const char = source[index];
      if (quoted) {
        if (char === '"' && source[index + 1] === '"') { field += '"'; index += 1; }
        else if (char === '"') { quoted = false; closed = true; }
        else field += char;
      } else if (char === '"') {
        if (field || closed) throw new Error("不正な引用符です");
        quoted = true;
      } else if (char === ",") {
        row.push(field); field = ""; closed = false;
      } else if (char === "\n" || char === "\r") {
        if (char === "\r" && source[index + 1] === "\n") index += 1;
        row.push(field);
        if (row.some((value) => value !== "")) rows.push(row);
        row = []; field = ""; closed = false;
      } else {
        if (closed) throw new Error("引用符の後に不正な文字があります");
        field += char;
      }
    }
    if (quoted) throw new Error("引用符が閉じていません");
    if (field || closed || row.length) { row.push(field); rows.push(row); }
    return rows;
  }

  function parseQuestions(text) {
    const rows = parseCSV(text);
    if (JSON.stringify(rows.shift()) !== JSON.stringify(headers) || rows.length !== 400) throw new Error("400問の列構成と一致しません");
    const ids = new Set();
    const counts = new Map();
    const questions = rows.map((row) => {
      if (row.length !== headers.length || row.some((value) => !value.trim())) throw new Error("問題に空欄があります");
      const [number, target, word, correct, wrong1, wrong2, status] = row;
      const id = Number(number);
      if (!Number.isInteger(id) || id < 1 || id > 400 || ids.has(id) || !kanji.includes(target) || !word.includes(target) || new Set([correct, wrong1, wrong2]).size !== 3) throw new Error("問題番号・漢字・選択肢が不正です");
      ids.add(id);
      counts.set(target, (counts.get(target) || 0) + 1);
      return Object.freeze({ id, target, word, correct, choices: Object.freeze([correct, wrong1, wrong2]), status });
    });
    if (counts.size !== 80 || [...counts.values()].some((count) => count !== 5)) throw new Error("80字×5問と一致しません");
    return questions;
  }

  function shuffle(items) {
    const result = [...items];
    for (let index = result.length - 1; index > 0; index -= 1) {
      const random = new Uint32Array(1);
      crypto.getRandomValues(random);
      const other = Math.floor((random[0] / 4294967296) * (index + 1));
      [result[index], result[other]] = [result[other], result[index]];
    }
    return result;
  }

  // 日付やチェック操作順ではなく、CSV初出順で末尾の10字を重点範囲にする。
  function focusKanji(selected, order = kanji) {
    const checked = new Set(selected);
    return order.filter(k => checked.has(k)).slice(-10);
  }
  function pickFocusedQuestions({questions, selected, order = kanji, history = {}, total, shuffleFn = shuffle}) {
    const checked = new Set(selected), focus = new Set(focusKanji(selected, order));
    const target = q => q.k ?? q.target;
    const all = questions.filter(q => checked.has(target(q)));
    if (!all.length) throw new Error("かんじを 1ついじょう えらんでね！");
    const focused = all.filter(q => focus.has(target(q)));
    const earlier = all.filter(q => !focus.has(target(q)));
    const used = new Set(), appearances = new Map(), chosen = [];
    const rank = q => { const h = history[q.id]; return !h?.seen ? 0 : h.wrong > 0 ? 1 : 2; };
    const lastSeen = q => Number.isFinite(history[q.id]?.lastSeen) ? history[q.id].lastSeen : 0;
    function take(pool, count, block) {
      for (let n = 0; n < count; n++) {
        const candidates = shuffleFn(pool.filter(q => !used.has(q.id)));
        candidates.sort((a,b) => rank(a)-rank(b) || (appearances.get(target(a)) || 0)-(appearances.get(target(b)) || 0) || lastSeen(a)-lastSeen(b));
        const q = candidates[0]; if (!q) break;
        used.add(q.id); appearances.set(target(q), (appearances.get(target(q)) || 0)+1); block.push(q);
      }
    }
    // ちょうせんの三択10問・入力10問の両方に重点5問ずつを確保する。
    for (const size of total === 20 ? [10,10] : [total]) {
      const block = [];
      take(focused, Math.ceil(size / 2), block);
      take(earlier, size - block.length, block);
      while (block.length < size) {
        const before = block.length;
        take(all, size - block.length, block);
        if (block.length === before) used.clear(); // 全候補を使い切った場合だけ重複を許可。
      }
      chosen.push(...shuffleFn(block));
    }
    return chosen;
  }

  window.KanjiQuestions = Object.freeze({ kanji: Object.freeze(kanji), parseCSV, parseQuestions, shuffle, focusKanji, pickFocusedQuestions });
})();

"use strict";
(() => {
  const key = "kanji-reading-prototype-v1";
  const cardIds = new Set(window.REWARD_CARDS.map(card => card.id));
  const profilePattern = /^[1-4]-(?:[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-5])$/;
  const clone = value => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
  function normalize(raw) {
    if (!raw || typeof raw !== "object" || Array.isArray(raw) || !raw.users || typeof raw.users !== "object" || Array.isArray(raw.users)) throw new Error("ほぞんデータを よみこめません。おとなの方に しらせてね。");
    const result = clone(raw);
    for (const [id, u] of Object.entries(result.users)) {
      if (!profilePattern.test(id) || !u || !Number.isSafeInteger(u.stars) || u.stars < 0 || !Number.isInteger(u.practice) || u.practice < 0 || u.practice > 4 || !Array.isArray(u.selected) || !Array.isArray(u.log) || !u.history || typeof u.history !== "object" || Array.isArray(u.history)) throw new Error("ほぞんデータの かたちが ちがいます。おとなの方に しらせてね。");
      u.cardCounts ??= {};
      if (typeof u.cardCounts !== "object" || Array.isArray(u.cardCounts) || Object.entries(u.cardCounts).some(([card, count]) => !cardIds.has(card) || !Number.isInteger(count) || count < 0 || count > 4)) throw new Error("カードの きろくを よみこめません。");
    }
    result.active ??= "";
    if (result.active && (!profilePattern.test(result.active) || !Object.hasOwn(result.users, result.active))) throw new Error("とうろくを たしかめてね。");
    return result;
  }
  function read() {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
    return raw === null ? { users: {}, active: "" } : normalize(JSON.parse(raw));
  }
  async function transact(change) {
    const run = () => {
      const next = read();
      const result = change(next);
      const checked = normalize(next);
      localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(checked));
      return { data: checked, result };
    };
    if (navigator.locks?.request) return navigator.locks.request(key, run);
    return run();
  }
  function profile(data, id) {
    if (!id || data.active !== id || !Object.hasOwn(data.users, id)) throw new Error("とうろくが かわったよ。じゅんびがめんに もどってね。");
    return data.users[id];
  }
  function freshProfile() { return { selected: [], stars: 0, practice: 0, history: {}, lastHomework: "", log: [], collection: [], cardCounts: {} }; }
  window.GameStore = Object.freeze({ key, read, transact, profile, freshProfile, profilePattern });
})();

function initApp(fetch,setTimeout,previewListen){
"use strict";
(() => {
  const store = window.GameStore;
  const app = document.getElementById("app");
  let QUESTIONS = [], KANJI = [], data = { users: {}, active: "" };
  let loginVisible = false;
  let kanaInput = "";
  const teacherTestAccess = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("teacher-test") === "1";
  let screen = "home", game = null, review = null, feedback = null, timer = null, warning = "", saving = false;
  const esc = x => String(x).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c]));
  function questionWord(q) {
    const selected = new Set(user()?.selected || []);
    const parts = window.WORD_READINGS[String(q.id)];
    // CSVの語彙が更新されても、古い読み補助データで問題文を上書きしない。
    if (!parts || parts.map(([text]) => text).join("") !== q.w) return esc(q.w);
    return parts.map(([text, reading]) => {
      // 熟字訓など語全体の読みは補助表示しない。
      const needsReading = reading && Array.from(text).length === 1 && !selected.has(text);
      return needsReading ? `<ruby>${esc(text)}<rp>（</rp><rt>${esc(reading)}</rt><rp>）</rp></ruby>` : esc(text);
    }).join("");
  }
  const shuffle = window.KanjiQuestions.shuffle;
  const today = () => new Intl.DateTimeFormat("sv-SE", { timeZone: "Asia/Tokyo", year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit" }).format(new Date());
  const practiceToday = u => u.log.filter(log => log.mode === "practice" && log.date && new Intl.DateTimeFormat("sv-SE", { timeZone: "Asia/Tokyo", year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit" }).format(new Date(log.date)) === today()).length;
  const user = () => data.users[data.active];
  const b = (text, action, classes = "") => `<button type="button" class="${classes}" onclick="${esc(action)}" ${saving ? "disabled" : ""}>${text}</button>`;
  function cancelTimer() { clearTimeout(timer); timer = null; }
  async function update(change) {
    if (saving) return false;
    saving = true;
    try { const result = await store.transact(change); data = result.data; warning = ""; return true; }
    catch (error) { warning = "ほぞんできませんでした。星やカードは かえていません。 " + (error.name === "Error" ? error.message : "端末の ほぞんせっていを おとなの方に たしかめてもらってね。"); return false; }
    finally { saving = false; }
  }
  function showLogin() { loginVisible = true; render(); document.getElementById("cls")?.focus(); }
  async function startLogin() {
    const cls = document.getElementById("cls").value, num = document.getElementById("num").value;
    const id = cls + "-" + num;
    if (!store.profilePattern.test(id)) { warning = "くみと ばんごうを えらんでね。"; render(); return; }
    if (await update(next => { if (!next.users[id]) next.users[id] = { ...store.freshProfile(), stars: 4, welcomeGiftReceived: true }; next.active = id; })) screen = "select";
    render();
  }
  async function changeUser() {
    if (game && !game.committed) {
      if (!confirm(game.mode === "practice" ? "とちゅうで やめる？ しゅぎょうは 1かいに かぞえるよ。" : "とちゅうの もんだいは きろくされません。もどりますか？")) return;
      const current = game;
      if (current.mode === "practice") {
        const ok = await update(next => {
          const u = store.profile(next, current.profile);
          if (!u.log.some(log => log.id === current.id)) {
            if (practiceToday(u) >= 5) throw new Error("きょうの しゅぎょうは 5かい おわっています。");
            u.log.push({ id: current.id, date: new Date().toISOString(), mode: "practice", score: null, award: 0, aborted: true });
          }
        });
        if (!ok) { render(); return; }
      }
    }
    if (await update(next => { next.active = ""; })) { cancelTimer(); game = review = feedback = null; screen = "home"; loginVisible = false; }
    render();
  }
  async function toggle(k) {
    const id = data.active;
    await update(next => { const u = store.profile(next, id); u.selected = u.selected.includes(k) ? u.selected.filter(x => x !== k) : [...u.selected, k]; }); render();
  }
  async function selectAll(value) {
    const id = data.active;
    await update(next => { store.profile(next, id).selected = value ? [...KANJI] : []; }); render();
  }
  function available() { const set = new Set(user().selected); return QUESTIONS.filter(q => set.has(q.k)); }
  function poolQuestions(total, prioritize = true) {
    if (prioritize) return window.KanjiQuestions.pickFocusedQuestions({questions: QUESTIONS, selected: user().selected, order: KANJI, history: user().history, total}).map(q => ({ ...q, opts: shuffle([q.r, ...q.wrong]) }));
    const all = available(), history = user().history;
    // 添付試作版の暫定配分を維持。正式な習熟度の計算は未確定。
    const unseen = shuffle(all.filter(q => !history[q.id]));
    const weak = shuffle(all.filter(q => history[q.id]?.wrong > 0)).sort((a, b) => history[b.id].wrong - history[a.id].wrong);
    const rest = shuffle(all.filter(q => history[q.id]));
    const chosen = [], ids = new Set();
    function add(items, n) { for (const q of items) { if (chosen.length >= total || n <= 0) break; if (ids.has(q.id)) continue; chosen.push(q); ids.add(q.id); n--; } }
    add(unseen, 5); add(weak, 3); add(rest, total - chosen.length); add(shuffle(all), total - chosen.length);
    while (chosen.length < total) chosen.push(...shuffle(all).slice(0, total - chosen.length));
    return shuffle(chosen).map(q => ({ ...q, opts: shuffle([q.r, ...q.wrong]) }));
  }
  function isKanaQuestion() {
    if (!game || !["play", "review"].includes(screen)) return false;
    const q = screen === "review" ? review?.items[review.idx] : game.items[game.idx];
    return !!q?.kanaMode;
  }
  const kanaReading = value => String(value).normalize("NFKC").replace(/[ァ-ヶ]/g, c => String.fromCharCode(c.charCodeAt(0) - 96));
  const kanaColumns = ["あいうえお","かきくけこ","さしすせそ","たちつてと","なにぬねの","はひふへほ","まみむめも","やゆよ","らりるれろ","わをん"];
  const dakuten = {か:"が",き:"ぎ",く:"ぐ",け:"げ",こ:"ご",さ:"ざ",し:"じ",す:"ず",せ:"ぜ",そ:"ぞ",た:"だ",ち:"ぢ",つ:"づ",て:"で",と:"ど",は:"ば",ひ:"び",ふ:"ぶ",へ:"べ",ほ:"ぼ"};
  const handakuten = {は:"ぱ",ひ:"ぴ",ふ:"ぷ",へ:"ぺ",ほ:"ぽ"};
  const smallKana = {あ:"ぁ",い:"ぃ",う:"ぅ",え:"ぇ",お:"ぉ",や:"ゃ",ゆ:"ゅ",よ:"ょ",つ:"っ",わ:"ゎ"};
  function kanaKey(key) {
    if (!isKanaQuestion() || feedback || saving || !["play","review"].includes(screen)) return;
    if (key === "delete") kanaInput = kanaInput.slice(0,-1);
    else if (key === "clear") kanaInput = "";
    else if (["dakuten","handakuten","small"].includes(key)) {
      const map = key === "dakuten" ? dakuten : key === "handakuten" ? handakuten : smallKana;
      const last = kanaInput.slice(-1);
      if (map[last]) kanaInput = kanaInput.slice(0,-1) + map[last];
    } else if (/^[ぁ-ゖー]$/.test(key) && [...kanaInput].length < 15) kanaInput += key;
    const field = document.getElementById("kana-answer");
    if (field) {
      field.textContent = kanaInput || "よみかたを いれてね";
      field.classList.toggle("empty", !kanaInput);
      field.style.fontSize = [...kanaInput].length > 11 ? "clamp(18px,3vw,27px)" : "";
    }
    const submit = document.getElementById("kana-submit");
    if (submit) submit.disabled = !kanaInput;
  }
  function kanaKeyboard() {
    const columns = [...kanaColumns].reverse().map(column => `<div class="kana-column">${[...column].map(ch => ch === " " ? '<span class="kana-spacer"></span>' : b(esc(ch), "kanaKey('"+ch+"')", "kana-key")).join("")}</div>`).join("");
    return `<div class="kana-keyboard" aria-label="50おんキーボード"><div class="kana-side kana-side-left">${b("゛<small>てんてん</small>","kanaKey('dakuten')","kana-key")}${b("゜<small>まる</small>","kanaKey('handakuten')","kana-key")}${b("ちいさく","kanaKey('small')","kana-key")}${b("ー","kanaKey('ー')","kana-key")}</div><div class="kana-columns">${columns}</div><div class="kana-side kana-side-right">${b("1もじ けす","kanaKey('delete')","kana-key")}${b("ぜんぶ けす","kanaKey('clear')","kana-key")}<button type="button" id="kana-submit" class="kana-key primary" onclick="kanaSubmit()" ${!kanaInput || feedback || saving ? "disabled" : ""}>こたえを きめる</button></div></div>`;
  }
  async function kanaSubmit() {
    if (!kanaInput || feedback || saving || !isKanaQuestion()) return;
    const q = screen === "review" ? review?.items[review.idx] : screen === "play" ? game.items[game.idx] : null;
    if (!q) return;
    const ok = kanaInput === kanaReading(q.r);
    if (screen === "play") await recordAnswer(ok, -1);
    else reviewRecord(ok, -1);
  }
  function begin(mode) {
    if (saving || !["homework", "practice", "free", "teacherTest"].includes(mode)) return;
    if (mode === "teacherTest" && !teacherTestAccess) return;
    try { data = store.read(); } catch { warning = "きろくを よみこめません。"; render(); return; }
    if (!user()) { screen = "home"; render(); return; }
    if (mode !== "teacherTest" && !available().length) { warning = "かんじを 1ついじょう えらんでね！"; render(); return; }
    if (mode === "homework" && user().lastHomework === today()) { warning = "きょうの ちょうせんは おわっているよ！"; render(); return; }
    if (mode === "practice" && practiceToday(user()) >= 5) { warning = "きょうの しゅぎょうは おわったよ。また あした！"; render(); return; }
    warning = ""; kanaInput = ""; game = { id: crypto.randomUUID(), profile: data.active, mode, items: mode === "teacherTest" ? shuffle(QUESTIONS).slice(0, 20).map(q => ({ ...q, opts: shuffle([q.r, ...q.wrong]) })) : poolQuestions(mode === "homework" ? 20 : mode === "practice" ? 15 : 10, mode !== "free"), idx: 0, answers: [], committed: false, awarded: 0, reviewFinished: false };
    game.items = game.items.map((q, index) => ({ ...q, kanaMode: mode === "teacherTest" || mode === "homework" && index >= 10 }));
    review = feedback = null; screen = "play"; render();
  }
  async function commitGame() {
    if (game.committed) return true;
    if (game.mode === "teacherTest") { game.committed = true; game.awarded = 0; return true; }
    const current = game;
    const score = current.answers.filter(x => x.ok).length;
    let award = 0;
    const ok = await update(next => {
      const u = store.profile(next, current.profile);
      const prior = u.log.find(log => log.id === current.id);
      if (prior) { award = prior.award; return; }
      if (current.mode === "homework") {
        if (u.lastHomework === today()) throw new Error("きょうの ちょうせんは すでに きろくされています。");
        award = score === current.items.length ? 2 : score >= current.items.length / 2 ? 1 : 0; u.lastHomework = today();
      } else if (current.mode === "practice") { if (practiceToday(u) >= 5) throw new Error("きょうの しゅぎょうは 5かい おわっています。また あした！"); if (score >= 13) u.practice++; if (u.practice >= 5) { award = 1; u.practice = 0; } }
      let sequence = Math.max(Number(u.questionSequence) || 0, ...Object.values(u.history).map(h => Number(h?.lastSeen) || 0));
      for (const answer of current.answers) { const h = u.history[answer.id] ?? { seen: 0, correct: 0, wrong: 0 }; h.seen++; h.lastSeen = ++sequence; if (answer.ok) h.correct++; else h.wrong++; u.history[answer.id] = h; }
      u.questionSequence = sequence;
      u.stars += award;
      u.log.push({ id: current.id, date: new Date().toISOString(), mode: current.mode, score, award });
    });
    if (ok) { current.committed = true; current.awarded = award; }
    return ok;
  }
  async function answer(index) {
    if (feedback || !game || screen !== "play" || isKanaQuestion()) return;
    const current = game;
    const q = current.items[current.idx];
    if (!Number.isInteger(index) || !q.opts[index]) return;
    const ok = q.opts[index] === q.r;
    await recordAnswer(ok, index);
  }
  async function recordAnswer(ok, choice) {
    if (feedback || !game || screen !== "play") return;
    const current = game;
    feedback = { ok, choice }; game.answers.push({ id: current.items[current.idx].id, ok });
    render(); // 正誤はタップした処理内ですぐ表示。
    if (current.answers.length === current.items.length) { await commitGame(); if (game !== current) return; render(); }
    cancelTimer();
    timer = setTimeout(() => { if (screen !== "play" || game !== current) return; feedback = null; kanaInput = ""; game.idx++; if (game.idx >= game.items.length) screen = "result"; render(); }, ok ? (isKanaQuestion() ? 1000 : 1500) : 2000);
  }
  async function retryCommit() { if (await commitGame()) warning = ""; render(); }
  async function quit() {
    if (game?.committed) { nav("result"); return; }
    if (!game) return;
    const current = game;
    if (current.mode === "teacherTest") { cancelTimer(); game = review = feedback = null; kanaInput = ""; screen = "select"; render(); return; }
    const isPractice = current.mode === "practice";
    if (!confirm(isPractice ? "とちゅうで やめる？ しろ☆は もらえないけれど、きょうの 5かいの うち 1かいに かぞえるよ。" : "とちゅうで やめる？ さいごまで おわっていないと きろくは のこらないよ。")) return;
    cancelTimer();
    if (isPractice) {
      const ok = await update(next => {
        const u = store.profile(next, current.profile);
        if (u.log.some(log => log.id === current.id)) return;
        if (practiceToday(u) >= 5) throw new Error("きょうの しゅぎょうは 5かい おわっています。");
        u.log.push({ id: current.id, date: new Date().toISOString(), mode: "practice", score: null, award: 0, aborted: true });
      });
      if (!ok) { render(); return; }
    }
    if (game !== current) return;
    game = review = feedback = null; screen = "select"; render();
  }
  function startReview() {
    if (!game?.committed) return;
    const missed = game.items.filter((q, i) => !game.answers[i].ok);
    const unique = [...new Map(missed.map(q => [q.id, q])).values()];
    if (!unique.length) return;
    review = { round: 1, items: shuffle(unique.map(q => ({ ...q, opts: shuffle([q.r, ...q.wrong]) }))), idx: 0, failed: [] };
    kanaInput = ""; feedback = null; screen = "review"; render();
  }
  function reviewAnswer(index) {
    if (feedback || screen !== "review" || isKanaQuestion()) return;
    const q = review.items[review.idx], ok = q.opts[index] === q.r;
    reviewRecord(ok, index);
  }
  function reviewRecord(ok, choice) {
    if (feedback || screen !== "review") return;
    const q = review.items[review.idx];
    feedback = { ok, choice }; if (!ok) review.failed.push(q); render(); cancelTimer();
    timer = setTimeout(() => {
      if (screen !== "review") return;
      feedback = null; kanaInput = ""; review.idx++;
      if (review.idx >= review.items.length) {
        if (review.round === 1 && review.failed.length) review = { round: 2, items: shuffle(review.failed.map(q => ({ ...q, opts: shuffle([q.r, ...q.wrong]) }))), idx: 0, failed: [] };
        else { game.reviewFinished = true; screen = "reviewDone"; }
      }
      render();
    }, ok ? (isKanaQuestion() ? 1000 : 1500) : 2000);
  }
  function nav(to) { cancelTimer(); feedback = review = null; if (to !== "result") game = null; screen = to; warning = ""; render(); }
  function goRewards(page) { cancelTimer(); location.hash = page; }
  function repeatTrainingButton() {
    if (game?.mode !== "practice" || !game.committed) return "";
    if (practiceToday(user()) >= 5) return '<p class="reward-rule">きょうの しゅぎょうは 5かい おわったよ。また あした！</p>';
    return b("もういちど しゅぎょう", "begin('practice')", "primary full");
  }
  function render() {
    document.body.classList.toggle("title-mode", !loginVisible);
    if (!loginVisible) {
      app.innerHTML = `<section class="title-screen" aria-label="かん字 ファンタジア"><div class="title-art"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="かん字 ファンタジア。月明かりの魔法の図書館" fetchpriority="high"><button type="button" class="title-start" onclick="showLogin()" aria-label="ゲームをはじめる"><span class="visually-hidden">ゲームをはじめる</span></button></div></section>`;
      return;
    }
    let html = `<h1>🌸 かん字ファンタジア</h1>`;
    if (warning) html += `<div class="notice" role="alert">${esc(warning)}</div>`;
    if (!data.active) {
      html += `<section class="card stack"><h2>はじめに おしえてね</h2><div class="login"><label>なんくみ？<select id="cls"><option value="">えらぶ</option>${Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, i) => `<option value="${i + 1}">${i + 1}くみ</option>`).join("")}</select></label><label>なんばん？<select id="num"><option value="">えらぶ</option>${Array.from({ length: 35 }, (_, i) => `<option value="${i + 1}">${i + 1}ばん</option>`).join("")}</select></label></div>${b("はじめる", "startLogin()", "primary full")}<p class="muted">記録はこの端末のブラウザー内に保存します。別の端末への引き継ぎ・先生のサーバーとは未連携です。</p></section>`;
      app.innerHTML = html; return;
    }
    const u = user();
    html += `<div class="row user-header"><span class="badge">${esc(data.active.replace("-", "くみ "))}ばん</span><span class="badge" id="learning-stars"><span class="gold-star" aria-hidden="true">★</span> きん☆ ${u.stars}こ</span><span class="badge" id="white-stars"><span class="white-star" aria-hidden="true">★</span> しろ☆ ${u.practice}こ</span>${b("とうろく きりかえ", "changeUser()", "small secondary")}</div>`;
    if (screen === "home") screen = "select";
    if (screen === "select") html += `<section class="card"><h2>① ならった かんじを えらぼう！</h2><p class="muted">タッチで えらぶ・もういちどで はずす</p><div class="row"><span class="badge">${u.selected.length} / 80じ</span><div class="buttons">${b("ぜんぶ えらぶ", "selectAll(true)", "small secondary")}${b("ぜんぶ はずす", "selectAll(false)", "small secondary")}</div></div><div class="grid">${KANJI.map(k => `<button type="button" class="kanji ${u.selected.includes(k) ? "on" : ""}" aria-label="${k}" aria-pressed="${u.selected.includes(k)}" onclick="toggle('${k}')" ${saving ? "disabled" : ""}>${k}</button>`).join("")}</div><p class="muted">えらんだ かんじの ことば：${available().length}もん</p><p class="reward-rule" id="focus-kanji">じゅうてんの かんじ（がくしゅうじゅんで さいごの10じまで）：${window.KanjiQuestions.focusKanji(u.selected, KANJI).map(esc).join("・") || "かんじを えらんでね"}</p></section><section class="card stack"><h2>② モードを えらぼう！</h2><p>🏠 ちょうせんモード：1にち 1かい（20もん）</p><p class="reward-rule" id="challenge-input-guide">はじめの 10もんは 3たく。<br>あとの 10もんは 50おんキーボードで よみかたを いれよう！</p><p class="reward-rule">20もん ぜんぶ せいかいで きん☆ 2こ！<br>10〜19もん せいかいで きん☆ 1こ。</p><button type="button" class="primary full" onclick="begin('homework')" ${u.lastHomework === today() || saving ? "disabled" : ""}>${u.lastHomework === today() ? "✓ きょうの ちょうせんは おわったよ" : "ちょうせんを はじめる"}</button><p>✏️ しゅぎょうモード：1にち 5かいまで（1かい 15もん・とちゅうで やめても 1かい）（きょう あと ${Math.max(0, 5 - practiceToday(u))}かい）</p><p class="reward-rule">15もんの うち はじめの こたえで 13もん いじょう せいかいすると しろ☆ 1こ！<br>12もん いかでも、とちゅうで やめても 1にち 5かいの うち 1かいに かぞえるよ。<br>しろ☆ 5こで きん☆ 1こに なるよ。</p><p>いま しろ☆ ${u.practice}こ。あと ${5 - u.practice}こで きん☆ 1こ！</p><button type="button" class="full secondary" onclick="begin('practice')" ${practiceToday(u) >= 5 || saving ? "disabled" : ""}>${practiceToday(u) >= 5 ? "✓ きょうの しゅぎょうは おわったよ" : "しゅぎょうを はじめる"}</button><p>📚 むげんれんしゅうモード：1セット 10もん</p><p class="reward-rule">1にち なんかいでも できるよ。<br>きん☆・しろ☆は もらえないよ。</p>${b("むげんれんしゅうを はじめる", "begin('free')", "full secondary")}${teacherTestAccess ? `<div class="teacher-test-panel"><h3>先生用 50音入力テスト</h3><p>カード0枚でも確認できます。星・カード・学習履歴は変更しません。テストは20問です。</p>${b("50音入力をテストする", "begin('teacherTest')", "primary full")}</div>` : ""}<div class="result-links">${b("🎁 ガチャ", "goRewards('gacha')", "full")}${b("📖 ずかん", "goRewards('collection')", "full")}</div></section>`;
    if (screen === "play" || screen === "review") {
      const isReview = screen === "review", q = isReview ? review.items[review.idx] : game.items[game.idx];
      const num = isReview ? review.idx + 1 : game.idx + 1, max = isReview ? review.items.length : game.items.length;
      const typing = isKanaQuestion();
      const kanaStatus = game.mode === "homework" ? `<span class="kana-mode-status">${typing ? "⌨️ 11〜20もん：50おんキーボード" : "1〜10もん：3たく"}</span>` : "";
      html += `<section class="card play-card ${typing ? "kana-play" : ""}" data-question-id="${q.id}"><div class="question-toolbar"><strong>${isReview ? "ふくしゅう " + review.round + "かいめ" : game.mode === "homework" ? "ちょうせん" : game.mode === "teacherTest" ? "せんせい テスト" : game.mode === "practice" ? "しゅぎょう" : "むげんれんしゅう"} ${num} / ${max}</strong>${kanaStatus}${b("やめる", isReview ? "nav('result')" : "quit()", "small secondary")}</div><div class="progress" role="progressbar" aria-label="こたえた もんだい" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="${max}" aria-valuenow="${num - 1}"><div style="width:${(num - 1) / max * 100}%"></div></div><div class="answer-display"><div class="feedback ${feedback ? feedback.ok ? "good" : "bad" : ""}" role="status" aria-live="polite">${feedback ? feedback.ok ? "○ せいかい！" : "× たしかめよう" : ""}</div><div class="question remember-word">${typing ? esc(q.w) : questionWord(q)}</div><div class="reading-slot"><div class="remember-reading" ${feedback ? "" : 'style="visibility:hidden" aria-hidden="true"'}>${esc(q.r)}</div>${feedback ? "" : `<p class="muted reading-prompt">${typing ? "つぎの かん字の よみかたを いれよう" : "ただしい よみかたを えらぼう！"}</p>`}</div></div><div class="choices">${typing ? `<div class="kana-answer-row"><div id="kana-answer" class="kana-answer ${kanaInput ? "" : "empty"}">${esc(kanaInput || "よみかたを いれてね")}</div></div>${kanaKeyboard()}` : q.opts.map((option, i) => `<button type="button" ${feedback ? "disabled" : ""} class="choice ${feedback ? option === q.r ? "correct" : i === feedback.choice ? "wrong" : "" : ""}" onclick="${isReview ? "reviewAnswer" : "answer"}(${i})">${esc(option)}</button>`).join("")}</div></section>`;
    }
    if (screen === "result") {
      const score = game.answers.filter(a => a.ok).length, missed = game.items.length - score;
      html += `<section class="card stack"><h2>けっか はっぴょう！</h2><div class="big">${score} / ${game.items.length}</div><div class="big star">${game.mode === "free" || game.mode === "teacherTest" ? "" : game.committed && game.mode === "practice" ? (score >= 13 ? '<span class="white-star">★</span>' : '☆') : "★".repeat(game.awarded) || "☆"}</div><p style="text-align:center">${game.committed ? game.mode === "teacherTest" ? "先生用テスト終了。星・カード・学習履歴は保存していません。" : game.mode === "free" ? "きろくを ほぞんしたよ。むげんれんしゅうでは ☆は ふえないよ。" : game.mode === "practice" ? (score >= 13 ? "13もん いじょう せいかい！ しろ☆ 1こ もらったよ！" + (game.awarded ? " しろ☆ 5こを きん☆ 1こに かえたよ！" : " あと " + (5 - u.practice) + "こで きん☆ 1こ！") : "こんかいは しろ☆ なし。1にち 5かいの うち 1かいに かぞえたよ。") : "きろくを ほぞんしたよ。こんかいの きん☆：" + game.awarded + "こ" : "まだ ほぞんできていません。"}</p>${!game.committed ? b("もういちど ほぞんする", "retryCommit()", "primary full") : ""}${missed && game.committed && !game.reviewFinished ? b("まちがえた もんだいを ふくしゅう", "startReview()", "primary full") : ""}${repeatTrainingButton()}${b("かんじを えらぶ がめんへ", "nav('select')", "secondary full")}<div class="result-links">${b("🎁 ガチャ", "goRewards('gacha')")}${b("📖 ずかん", "goRewards('collection')")}</div></section>`;
    }
    if (screen === "reviewDone") html += `<section class="card stack"><h2>ふくしゅう おしまい！</h2><p>がんばったね！ つぎも ちょうせんしよう。</p>${repeatTrainingButton()}${b("じゅんびがめんへ", "nav('select')", "primary full")}</section>`;
    html += `<p class="foot">400問の提供CSVを使用｜学級・番号別の端末内保存｜別端末への同期は未連携</p>`;
    app.innerHTML = html;
  }
  async function initialize() {
    try {
      const response = await fetch("data/kanji_400_final.csv?v=20261111-sync-v44", { cache: "no-store" }); if (!response.ok) throw new Error("問題をよみこめません。");
      QUESTIONS = window.KanjiQuestions.parseQuestions(await response.text()).map(q => ({ id: q.id, k: q.target, w: q.word, r: q.correct, wrong: q.choices.slice(1) }));
      KANJI = [...new Set(QUESTIONS.map(q => q.k))]; data = store.read(); render();
    } catch { app.innerHTML = `<section class="card"><h1>じゅんびを たしかめよう</h1><p>もんだい または きろくを よみこめませんでした。おとなの方に しらせてね。きろくは けしていません。</p><button type="button" onclick="location.reload()">もういちど よみこむ</button></section>`; }
  }
  Object.assign(window, { showLogin, startLogin, changeUser, toggle, selectAll, begin, answer, retryCommit, quit, startReview, reviewAnswer, kanaKey, kanaSubmit, nav, goRewards });
  previewListen("storage", event => { if (event.key !== store.key && event.key !== null) return; try { const next = store.read(); if (next.active !== data.active) { cancelTimer(); game = review = feedback = null; screen = "home"; } data = next; render(); } catch { warning = "きろくの へんこうを よみこめません。"; render(); } });
  initialize();
})();

}
function initRewards(setTimeout,previewListen){
"use strict";

(() => {
  const cards = window.REWARD_CARDS;
  const tiers = [
    { id: "normal", name: "ノーマル", required: 1 },
    { id: "gold", name: "ゴールド", required: 2 },
    { id: "rainbow", name: "レインボー", required: 3 },
    { id: "variant", name: "亜種（あしゅ）", required: 4 },
  ];
  const integrated = !new URLSearchParams(location.search).has("demo");
  const storageKey = integrated ? window.GameStore.key : "kanji-reading-game:rewards-demo:v1";
  let profileId = "";
  if (integrated) {
    try { profileId = window.GameStore.read().active; } catch { /* Handled by refreshState below. */ }
  }
  const storageMessage = document.getElementById("storage-message");
  const page = document.body.dataset.page;
  let state;
  let storageOK = true;
  let busy = false;
  let filter = "all";
  let lastFocus;

  function initialState() {
    return { version: 1, stars: integrated ? 0 : 3, counts: {} };
  }

  function readState() {
    if (integrated) {
      const u = window.GameStore.profile(window.GameStore.read(), profileId);
      return { version: 1, stars: u.stars, counts: { ...u.cardCounts } };
    }
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
    if (raw === null) return initialState();
    const value = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (!value || value.version !== 1 || !Number.isInteger(value.stars) || value.stars < 0 || value.stars > 999 || !value.counts || typeof value.counts !== "object" || Array.isArray(value.counts)) {
      throw new Error("Invalid reward state");
    }
    for (const [id, count] of Object.entries(value.counts)) {
      if (!cards.some((card) => card.id === id) || !Number.isInteger(count) || count < 0 || count > tiers.length) throw new Error("Invalid card count");
    }
    return { version: 1, stars: value.stars, counts: { ...value.counts } };
  }

  function refreshState() {
    try {
      state = readState();
      storageOK = true;
      storageMessage.textContent = "";
    } catch {
      storageOK = false;
      state = initialState();
      storageMessage.textContent = integrated ? "とうろくや きろくを よみこめません。かんじの がめんで くみ・ばんごうを たしかめてね。" : "おためしの記録を よみこめません。ガチャは おやすみ中です。おとなの方に しらせてね。";
    }
  }

  async function saveState(next) {
    try {
      if (integrated) {
        await window.GameStore.transact(data => {
          const u = window.GameStore.profile(data, profileId);
          if (u.stars !== state.stars || JSON.stringify(u.cardCounts) !== JSON.stringify(state.counts)) throw new Error("記録が更新されました");
          u.stars = next.stars;
          u.cardCounts = { ...next.counts };
        });
      } else localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(next));
      state = next;
      storageMessage.textContent = "";
      return true;
    } catch {
      storageOK = false;
      storageMessage.textContent = "ほぞんできなかったので、星もカードも かえていないよ。おとなの方に しらせてね。";
      return false;
    }
  }

  function countFor(card) {
    return state.counts[card.id] || 0;
  }

  function unlockedCount() {
    return cards.reduce((sum, card) => sum + countFor(card), 0);
  }

  function makeArt(card, tier, lazy = false) {
    const frame = document.createElement("div");
    frame.className = `card-art ${tier.id}`;
    const image = document.createElement("img");
    image.src = tier.id === "variant" ? card.variantImage : card.image;
    image.alt = `${card.name}の${tier.name}カード`;
    image.loading = lazy ? "lazy" : "eager";
    image.decoding = "async";
    image.addEventListener("error", () => {
      image.hidden = true;
      const message = document.createElement("p");
      message.textContent = "えを よみこめませんでした。";
      frame.append(message);
    }, { once: true });
    frame.append(image);
    if (tier.id === "gold" || tier.id === "rainbow") {
      const sparkles = document.createElement("span");
      sparkles.className = "foil-sparkles";
      sparkles.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      for (let index = 0; index < 8; index += 1) {
        const star = document.createElement("i");
        star.textContent = "✦";
        sparkles.append(star);
      }
      frame.append(sparkles);
    }
    return frame;
  }

  function renderGacha() {
    const complete = unlockedCount() === cards.length * tiers.length;
    document.getElementById("star-count").textContent = state.stars;
    const draw = document.getElementById("draw-card");
    draw.disabled = !storageOK || busy || complete || state.stars === 0;
    draw.textContent = complete ? "✦ ぜんぶ あつめたよ！" : "★ 1こで ハンドルをまわす";
    document.getElementById("machine-handle").disabled = draw.disabled;
    const add = document.getElementById("add-demo-stars");
    add.hidden = integrated;
    add.disabled = integrated || !storageOK || busy || complete || state.stars > 996;
    const message = document.getElementById("draw-message");
    if (complete) message.textContent = "コンプリート！ 132まいの たからものが そろったよ。";
    else if (state.stars === 0) message.textContent = integrated ? "ちょうせんや しゅぎょうで 星を あつめよう！" : "おためしの星を ふやすと、また ひけるよ。";
    else if (!busy) message.textContent = "星1こで 1かい。4まい あつめた なかまは もうでないよ。";
  }

  function showResult(card, count) {
    const tier = tiers[count - 1];
    document.getElementById("result-heading").textContent = count === 4 ? "あしゅに であえたよ！" : count === 1 ? "なかまが ふえたよ！" : "カードが かがやいたよ！";
    const result = document.getElementById("draw-result");
    result.replaceChildren(makeArt(card, tier));
    const title = document.createElement("h3");
    title.textContent = tier.id === "variant" ? `${card.name}・${card.variantName}` : card.name;
    const meta = document.createElement("p");
    meta.className = "result-meta";
    meta.textContent = `${count}まいめ · ${tier.name}カード`;
    result.append(title, meta);
    document.getElementById("draw-message").textContent = `${card.name}の ${tier.name}カードを ずかんに ほぞんしたよ！`;
  }

  async function drawCard() {
    if (busy) return;
    refreshState();
    const eligible = cards.filter((card) => countFor(card) < tiers.length);
    if (!storageOK || state.stars === 0 || eligible.length === 0) {
      renderGacha();
      return;
    }
    // おためし画面のみの等確率抽選。本番の排出率を確定するものではない。
    const random = new Uint32Array(1);
    crypto.getRandomValues(random);
    const card = eligible[Math.floor((random[0] / 4294967296) * eligible.length)];
    const count = countFor(card) + 1;
    const next = { ...state, stars: state.stars - 1, counts: { ...state.counts, [card.id]: count } };
    busy = true;
    renderGacha();
    if (!await saveState(next)) {
      busy = false;
      renderGacha();
      return;
    }
    const panel = document.querySelector(".summon-panel");
    panel.classList.add("is-drawing");
    panel.dataset.stage = "turn";
    const result = document.getElementById("draw-result");
    result.classList.remove("is-revealing");
    result.textContent = "カプセルの なかは なにかな…？";
    document.getElementById("result-heading").textContent = "ガチャガチャ…！";
    document.getElementById("draw-message").textContent = "ハンドルを ぐるっと まわしているよ！";
    const reveal = () => {
      if (!panel.isConnected) return;
      showResult(card, count);
      result.classList.add("is-revealing");
      panel.dataset.stage = "revealed";
      panel.classList.remove("is-drawing");
      busy = false;
      renderGacha();
    };
    if (matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) {
      setTimeout(reveal, 80);
      return;
    }
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (!panel.isConnected) return;
      panel.dataset.stage = "drop";
      document.getElementById("draw-message").textContent = "ころん！ カプセルが でてきたよ。";
    }, 850);
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (!panel.isConnected) return;
      panel.dataset.stage = "open";
      document.getElementById("draw-message").textContent = "ぱかっ！ カプセルが ひらくよ。";
    }, 1550);
    setTimeout(reveal, 2300);
  }

  function openDetail(card, tier, button) {
    lastFocus = button;
    document.getElementById("detail-card").replaceChildren(makeArt(card, tier));
    document.getElementById("detail-name").textContent = tier.id === "variant" ? `${card.name}・${card.variantName}` : card.name;
    document.getElementById("detail-tier").textContent = `No.${card.id} · ${tier.name}`;
    document.getElementById("detail-count").textContent = `この なかまは ${countFor(card)}まい もっているよ。`;
    document.getElementById("card-dialog").showModal();
  }

  function renderAlbum() {
    const total = unlockedCount();
    document.getElementById("collection-count").textContent = total;
    document.getElementById("collection-progress").value = total;
    const grid = document.getElementById("album-grid");
    const ownedOnly = document.getElementById("owned-only").checked;
    grid.replaceChildren();
    let visible = 0;
    let owned = 0;
    for (const card of cards) {
      for (const tier of tiers) {
        if (filter !== "all" && filter !== tier.id) continue;
        const unlocked = countFor(card) >= tier.required;
        if (ownedOnly && !unlocked) continue;
        visible += 1;
        if (unlocked) owned += 1;
        const entry = document.createElement("article");
        entry.className = "album-entry";
        entry.dataset.cardId = card.id;
        entry.dataset.tier = tier.id;
        const button = document.createElement("button");
        button.type = "button";
        button.className = "album-card-button";
        if (unlocked) {
          button.setAttribute("aria-label", `${card.name} ${tier.name}カードを おおきくみる`);
          button.append(makeArt(card, tier, true));
          button.addEventListener("click", () => openDetail(card, tier, button));
        } else {
          button.disabled = true;
          button.setAttribute("aria-label", `No.${card.id} ${tier.name} まだもっていないカード`);
          const back = document.createElement("div");
          back.className = "card-art locked-art";
          const mark = document.createElement("span");
          mark.textContent = "✧";
          mark.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
          const caption = document.createElement("small");
          caption.textContent = "まだ であっていないよ";
          back.append(mark, caption);
          button.append(back);
        }
        const label = document.createElement("p");
        label.className = "album-label";
        const number = document.createElement("span");
        number.textContent = `No.${card.id}`;
        const badge = document.createElement("span");
        badge.className = `tier-label ${tier.id}`;
        badge.textContent = tier.name;
        label.append(number, badge);
        const name = document.createElement("h2");
        name.textContent = unlocked ? card.name : "？？？";
        entry.append(button, label, name);
        grid.append(entry);
      }
    }
    document.getElementById("album-empty").hidden = visible !== 0;
    document.getElementById("album-summary").textContent = `${visible}まいを ひょうじ · ${owned}まい もっているよ`;
  }

  function render() {
    if (page === "gacha") renderGacha();
    else renderAlbum();
  }

  const note = document.getElementById("profile-note");
  if (note) note.textContent = integrated ? (profileId ? `${profileId.replace("-", "くみ ")}ばんの 星とカード · この端末に保存` : "はじめに、かんじの がめんで くみ・ばんごうを とうろくしてね。") : "おためし · がくしゅうの星とは べつの記録です。";
  for (const element of document.querySelectorAll("[data-demo-only]")) element.hidden = integrated;
  if (!integrated) for (const link of document.querySelectorAll('a[href="gacha.html"], a[href="collection.html"]')) link.href += "?demo=1";
  refreshState();
  render();
  if (page === "gacha") {
    document.getElementById("draw-card").addEventListener("click", drawCard);
    document.getElementById("machine-handle").addEventListener("click", drawCard);
    document.getElementById("add-demo-stars").addEventListener("click", async () => {
      if (integrated || busy) return;
      refreshState();
      if (storageOK && state.stars <= 996 && unlockedCount() < cards.length * tiers.length) await saveState({ ...state, stars: state.stars + 3 });
      renderGacha();
    });
  } else {
    document.getElementById("tier-filters").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      const button = event.target.closest("button[data-filter]");
      if (!button) return;
      filter = button.dataset.filter;
      for (const item of document.querySelectorAll("[data-filter]")) item.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(item === button));
      renderAlbum();
    });
    document.getElementById("owned-only").addEventListener("change", renderAlbum);
    const dialog = document.getElementById("card-dialog");
    document.getElementById("close-detail").addEventListener("click", () => dialog.close());
    document.getElementById("detail-done").addEventListener("click", () => dialog.close());
    dialog.addEventListener("close", () => lastFocus?.isConnected && lastFocus.focus());
  }
  document.getElementById("reset-demo").addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (integrated || busy || !confirm("おためしの星とカードを すべてリセットしますか？ 学習の記録は変更しません。")) return;
    try {
      localStorage.removeItem(storageKey);
      refreshState();
      if (page === "gacha") {
        document.getElementById("draw-result").textContent = "ガチャをひくと、ここにカードが あらわれるよ。";
        document.getElementById("result-heading").textContent = "きみの なかまを よぼう";
      } else document.getElementById("card-dialog").close();
      render();
    } catch {
      storageMessage.textContent = "リセットできませんでした。";
    }
  });
  previewListen("storage", (event) => {
    if (event.key !== storageKey && event.key !== null) return;
    refreshState();
    if (page === "collection") document.getElementById("card-dialog").close();
    render();
  });
})();

}

let timers = [], listeners;
function showScreen() {
  for (const timer of timers) clearTimeout(timer);
  timers = [];
  listeners?.abort(); listeners = new AbortController();
  const requested = location.hash.slice(1).split('?')[0];
  const screen = Object.hasOwn(screens, requested) ? requested : 'game';
  document.body.dataset.page = screen;
  document.getElementById('screen-style').textContent = styles[screen];
  document.body.innerHTML = screens[screen];
  const schedule = (fn, ms) => {const timer = window.setTimeout(fn, ms); timers.push(timer); return timer;};
  const listen = (event, fn) => window.addEventListener(event, fn, {signal: listeners.signal});
  if (screen === 'game') initApp(async () => new Response(questionCSV, {status: 200}), schedule, listen);
  else initRewards(schedule, listen);
  scrollTo(0, 0);
}
window.addEventListener('hashchange', () => {if (Object.hasOwn(screens, location.hash.slice(1).split('?')[0])) showScreen();});
showScreen();
</script></body></html>
